story.title: Princess Kaguya
story.description: A bamboo cutter finds a tiny, glowing girl inside a bamboo stalk - and raises a princess of the Moon who must one day return home.
story.author: Traditional Japanese folklore (The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, 10th century)

chapters.name: The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter
chapters.summary: The central conflict and its participants are introduced.

chapters.name: Confrontation
chapters.summary: The consequences grow and the characters must choose how to respond.

chapters.name: Resolution
chapters.summary: The main threads converge and reveal their consequences.

scenes.name: A child in the bamboo
scenes.summary: While cutting bamboo in the grove, an old bamboo cutter finds a single glowing stalk holding a tiny, beautiful girl; he and his wife take her in and raise her as their own.

scenes.name: Growing like bamboo in spring
scenes.summary: The child grows to full maturity in only three months; she is named Kaguya-hime, and her radiant beauty draws suitors from every corner of the land.

scenes.name: The five impossible treasures
scenes.summary: Five noble suitors court Kaguya-hime; to be rid of them without cruelty, she promises to marry whoever brings her one of five treasures said to be impossible to find - Buddha's stone bowl, a jeweled branch from Mount Horai, a robe of fire-rat fur, a jewel from a dragon's neck, and a cowrie shell born of a swallow.

scenes.name: Frauds and failures
scenes.summary: One by one the suitors return with forgeries and excuses - a soot-blackened bowl, a jeweler's fake branch, a robe that burns to ash - or come to grief chasing their prize, and Kaguya-hime sees through every trick.

scenes.name: The Emperor's courtship
scenes.summary: Even the Emperor of Japan is enchanted by reports of her beauty and asks for her hand; Kaguya-hime gently refuses marriage, though she and the Emperor exchange letters and grow fond of one another from a respectful distance.

scenes.name: A secret from the Moon
scenes.summary: As the fifteenth night of autumn approaches, Kaguya-hime grows sorrowful and confesses to her foster parents that she is not of this world - she is a princess of the Moon, and celestial envoys will soon come to take her home.

scenes.name: The robe of feathers
scenes.summary: Despite the Emperor's soldiers surrounding the house to protect her, a shining retinue descends from the sky on the night of the full moon; Kaguya-hime leaves a farewell letter and a vial of the elixir of immortality for the Emperor, then dons the celestial Robe of Feathers - which erases all earthly love and sorrow - before ascending to the Moon.

scenes.name: The mountain of immortality
scenes.summary: Grief-stricken, and knowing no life is worth living forever without her, the Emperor orders Kaguya-hime's letter and the elixir carried to the summit of the tallest mountain near the heavens and burned there; smoke is said to rise from its peak ever since - which is why the mountain came to be called Fuji, "immortal."

characters.name: Kaguya-hime
characters.title: Princess of the Moon
characters.description: A radiant girl found as an infant inside a glowing bamboo stalk, who grows into a beauty unlike any other - and turns out to be a princess of the Moon.
characters.personality: Graceful, clever, and quietly sorrowful about a fate she cannot share with those who love her.
characters.motivation: Wants to spare her foster parents pain for as long as possible, even as her true origin draws her back to the Moon.
characters.qualities: Sharp enough to see through five different suitors' impossible-treasure schemes without ever being deceived.
characters.weaknesses: Cannot resist the pull of the Moon once the appointed night arrives, no matter how much she wishes to stay.
characters.biography: A girl found as an infant inside a glowing bamboo stalk, raised by a childless bamboo cutter and his wife, who grows into unmatched beauty and turns out to be a princess of the Moon.
characters.plannedTimeline: Returns to the Moon on the night of the full autumn moon, leaving behind a farewell letter and the elixir of immortality.

characters.name: Taketori no Okina
characters.title: The Bamboo Cutter
characters.description: An elderly bamboo cutter who discovers Kaguya-hime as a baby and raises her as his own daughter, growing wealthy after finding gold inside bamboo stalks from that day on.
characters.personality: Hardworking and devoted, awed by the fortune that enters his life alongside Kaguya-hime.
characters.motivation: Wants to give his adopted daughter the finest life and marriage he can arrange.
characters.qualities: Honest and industrious - the gold he finds in the bamboo afterward is treated as a blessing tied to her, not exploited.
characters.weaknesses: Cannot protect Kaguya-hime from her true nature, however much wealth and status he gathers for her.
characters.biography: An elderly bamboo cutter who discovers Kaguya-hime as a baby and raises her as his own daughter, growing wealthy after finding gold inside bamboo stalks from that day on.
characters.plannedTimeline: Petitions the Emperor for soldiers to guard his house, but cannot stop the celestial retinue from taking Kaguya-hime home.

characters.name: The Bamboo Cutter's Wife
characters.description: The bamboo cutter's devoted wife, who helps raise Kaguya-hime and loves her as a true daughter.
characters.personality: Warm and nurturing, treating Kaguya-hime as a true daughter from the moment she is found.
characters.motivation: Wants nothing more than to see her adopted daughter happy and safe.
characters.qualities: Patient and loving, raising an extraordinary child without ever treating her as strange.
characters.weaknesses: Powerless, like her husband, to keep Kaguya-hime from the fate written in the stars.
characters.biography: The bamboo cutter's devoted wife, who helps raise Kaguya-hime and loves her as a true daughter.
characters.plannedTimeline: Grieves alongside her husband once Kaguya-hime's true origin and departure become unavoidable.

characters.name: The Emperor
characters.title: Emperor of Japan
characters.description: The ruler of Japan, captivated by reports of Kaguya-hime's beauty; he courts her respectfully and becomes, in time, a trusted friend.
characters.personality: Dignified and persistent, but ultimately respectful of Kaguya-hime's repeated refusals.
characters.motivation: Desires Kaguya-hime's hand in marriage, drawn by reports of her unmatched beauty.
characters.qualities: Patient enough to settle for friendship and correspondence when marriage is refused.
characters.weaknesses: His rank and power mean nothing against Kaguya-hime's true, otherworldly nature.
characters.biography: The ruler of Japan, captivated by reports of Kaguya-hime's beauty; he courts her respectfully and becomes, in time, a trusted friend.
characters.plannedTimeline: Receives Kaguya-hime's farewell letter and the elixir of immortality, and orders both burned atop the tallest mountain rather than live forever without her.

characters.name: Prince Ishitsukuri
characters.description: A suitor tasked with bringing Buddha's stone begging bowl from India; he commissions a fake instead, and is exposed when it fails to glow with holy light.
characters.personality: Confident and unwilling to admit defeat, even when caught in his own lie.
characters.motivation: Wants to win Kaguya-hime's hand by any means, including deception.
characters.qualities: Resourceful enough to commission a convincing fake in place of the real treasure.
characters.weaknesses: His fake bowl fails the one test that matters - it does not glow with holy light.
characters.biography: A suitor tasked with bringing Buddha's stone begging bowl from India; he commissions a fake instead, and is exposed when it fails to glow with holy light.
characters.plannedTimeline: Publicly humiliated once his forged bowl is exposed, and withdraws his suit.

characters.name: Prince Kuramochi
characters.description: A suitor tasked with bringing a jeweled branch from the legendary Mount Horai; he has a replica secretly crafted, but the artisans come demanding payment before Kaguya-hime, revealing the deception.
characters.personality: Elaborate and secretive, willing to go to great lengths to stage a convincing lie.
characters.motivation: Wants to appear as though he braved the legendary Mount Horai himself.
characters.qualities: Patient enough to have master craftsmen build a flawless replica branch.
characters.weaknesses: Never pays the artisans he hires, who come to collect their due at the worst possible moment.
characters.biography: A suitor tasked with bringing a jeweled branch from the legendary Mount Horai; he has a replica secretly crafted, but the artisans come demanding payment before Kaguya-hime, revealing the deception.
characters.plannedTimeline: Flees in shame once the unpaid craftsmen expose his fraud before Kaguya-hime herself.

characters.name: Minister Abe no Miemasa
characters.description: A wealthy suitor tasked with bringing a robe made from fire-rat fur; the costly robe he purchases burns to ash the moment it is tested in flame, proving it false.
characters.personality: Wealthy and confident that money alone can solve any challenge.
characters.motivation: Believes he can simply buy his way to Kaguya-hime's hand.
characters.qualities: Resourceful enough to track down and purchase a supposed fire-rat robe at great expense.
characters.weaknesses: Never verifies the merchant's claims before spending his fortune on a fake.
characters.biography: A wealthy suitor tasked with bringing a robe made from fire-rat fur; the costly robe he purchases burns to ash the moment it is tested in flame, proving it false.
characters.plannedTimeline: Watches his fortune and his suit go up in smoke together when the robe burns.

characters.name: Counselor Otomo no Miyuki
characters.description: A suitor who sails in search of a five-colored jewel from a dragon's neck; caught in a terrible storm he takes for the dragon's wrath, he abandons the quest and returns home ill and humbled.
characters.personality: Bold in ambition but quick to lose his nerve when real danger appears.
characters.motivation: Sets out personally to hunt a dragon for its five-colored jewel.
characters.qualities: Willing, at least at first, to risk a genuinely dangerous sea voyage rather than cheat.
characters.weaknesses: Abandons the quest entirely at the first storm, mistaking it for the dragon's wrath.
characters.biography: A suitor who sails in search of a five-colored jewel from a dragon's neck; caught in a terrible storm he takes for the dragon's wrath, he abandons the quest and returns home ill and humbled.
characters.plannedTimeline: Returns home seasick and humbled, withdrawing his suit entirely.

characters.name: Counselor Isonokami no Marotari
characters.description: A suitor who searches for a cowrie shell said to be born from a swallow; he falls while reaching into a swallow's nest for one and is gravely injured, ending his courtship.
characters.personality: Determined but physically unlucky, injured in his very first real attempt.
characters.motivation: Seeks a cowrie shell said to be born from a swallow, thought to ease childbirth.
characters.qualities: At least attempts the task honestly, unlike several of the other suitors.
characters.weaknesses: Falls before ever completing the task, ending his courtship in injury rather than deceit.
characters.biography: A suitor who searches for a cowrie shell said to be born from a swallow; he falls while reaching into a swallow's nest for one and is gravely injured, ending his courtship.
characters.plannedTimeline: Recovers from his injury but never renews his courtship of Kaguya-hime.

locations.name: The Bamboo Grove
locations.description: A grove near the bamboo cutter's home, where a single glowing stalk once held a child - and where Kaguya-hime was raised.
locations.climate: Quiet and green, alive with the rustle of tall bamboo stalks.
locations.culture: A humble rural life built around bamboo cutting and craft.

locations.name: The Capital
locations.description: The imperial capital, where nobles and the Emperor himself come to court the most beautiful woman in the land.
locations.climate: Bustling with the comings and goings of nobles and their retinues.
locations.culture: An aristocratic court preoccupied with beauty, poetry, and courtship rituals.
locations.politics: Home to the Emperor's court, the center of political power in Japan.

locations.name: Mount Fuji
locations.description: The tallest mountain near the heavens, chosen as the place closest to the Moon to burn Kaguya-hime's final letter.
locations.climate: Cold and remote, its peak closer to the heavens than anywhere else in the land.

worldRules.title: The Robe of Feathers
worldRules.description: Whoever dons the celestial Robe of Feathers instantly forgets all earthly attachment, love, and sorrow - which is why Kaguya-hime must say her farewells and write her final letter before the robe touches her shoulders, not after.

worldRules.title: Promises have weight
worldRules.description: A freely given promise changes what its speaker may safely do.

worldRules.title: Places remember
worldRules.description: Important locations retain signs of the events that happened there.
